name: What is the typical process for ADU zoning approval?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for ADU zoning approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process for ADU zoning approval begins with a detailed site analysis and preliminary design to assess feasibility against local zoning codes. Next, a zoning professional will prepare and submit a comprehensive application package to the relevant city planning department. This often involves reviewing architectural plans, site plans, and property surveys for compliance. Following submission, there may be a review period, potential requests for additional information, and eventual approval of the zoning aspects before moving to building permit applications.
acceptedAnswer.description: The ADU zoning approval process involves site analysis, preliminary design review, submission of an application package to the city, and a review period leading to approval.
